name: @repo/s2-agent-ext-superpowers
description: Pi-native port of Superpowers (Primer Radiant) — a complete software-development methodology built on 13 upstream-pinned composable skills + 1 repo-native (dispatch-recovery) (brainstorming, writing-plans, executing-plans, subagent-driven-development, test-driven-development, systematic-debugging, requesting/receiving-code-review, finishing-a-development-branch, using-git-worktrees, dispatching-parallel-agents, writing-skills, using-superpowers). Ships as a Layer-3 Pi extension: CSO-compliant skills discovered via resources_discover + a using-superpowers bootstrap that is injected into context on session_start/session_compact until the first agent_end, mirroring the upstream .pi/extensions/superpowers.ts. Skills pin-guarded against committed fixtures with sanctioned local divergences (UPSTREAM.ref); only the Pi extension wrapper is this package's own code. Pure TypeScript, no Python, no shell scripts of its own (skill resource scripts are upstream assets kept byte-identical).

scripts.test: bun run check && bun run test:unit
